title: Panthers pull out 20-17 win in New Orleans, take lead in NFC South

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Panthers pull out 20-17 win in New Orleans, take lead in NFC South
sources.description: NFC South football has earned a negative reputation over the last few years and Sunday's game between the Panthers and Saints didn't do much to change that, but it did push one of the teams into first place in the race to represent the division in the playoffs.
